test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 23 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: By selling 50 mangoes for Rs. 30, a person loses 10%. How many mangoes should he sell for Rs. 28 to gain 20%?
solution:
**Given,**

A person selling 50 mangoes for Rs. 30, incurs loss by = 10%

**Formula:**

CP = SP × 100/(100 – Loss%)

**Calculation:**

Selling price of 50 mangoes = 30

Selling price of 1 mango = 30/50

Cost price of 1 mango = 30/50 × 100/90 = RS. 2/3

Selling price of 1 mango, if he wants 20% profit = Rs. 2/3 × (120/100) = Rs. 4/5

The person sells in Rs. 4/5 = 1 mango

The person sells in Rs. 28 = 1 × 5/4 × 28 = 35 mango

**∴ The person sells 35 mango.**
